document_assessment.summary: Sample direct-edit checker output for validating exact-anchor preflight before Word tracked-change application.

batch_readiness.readiness_summary: The sample direct edit has one exact anchor in an editable source-note unit and no unresolved evidence request.

gates.finding: The target source note is a discrete extracted unit.
The original text appears exactly once in the target unit.
The correction concerns a formulaic classification-status phrase and requires no new archival fact.
The unit has no existing revisions or blocked Word boundaries in the fixture.

checks.finding: The source note uses the less precise phrase `No classification.` where FRUS form should identify the absence of a classification marking.
checks.standard: When the original document bears no classification marking, the source note should distinguish that absence from declassification status or handling restrictions.
